import java.util.Scanner;

public class Text_Document_Analysis {

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        String s = scanner.nextLine();
        scanner.close();
        
        int maxOutside = 0;
        int countInside = 0;
        
        int currentWordLength = 0;
        boolean insideParentheses = false;
        
        for (int i = 0; i < s.length(); i++) {
            char c = s.charAt(i);
            
            if (c == '(') {
                // Process the current word before entering parentheses
                if (!insideParentheses && currentWordLength > 0) {
                    maxOutside = Math.max(maxOutside, currentWordLength);
                    currentWordLength = 0;
                }
                insideParentheses = true;
            } else if (c == ')') {
                // Process the current word before exiting parentheses
                if (insideParentheses && currentWordLength > 0) {
                    countInside++;
                    currentWordLength = 0;
                }
                insideParentheses = false;
            } else if (c == '_') {
                // Process current word when encountering separator
                if (insideParentheses) {
                    if (currentWordLength > 0) {
                        countInside++;
                    }
                } else {
                    if (currentWordLength > 0) {
                        maxOutside = Math.max(maxOutside, currentWordLength);
                    }
                }
                currentWordLength = 0;
            } else if ((c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z') || (c >= 'a' && c <= 'z')) {
                currentWordLength++;
            }
        }
        
        // Process any remaining word at the end of string
        if (currentWordLength > 0) {
            if (insideParentheses) {
                countInside++;
            } else {
                maxOutside = Math.max(maxOutside, currentWordLength);
            }
        }
        
        System.out.println(maxOutside + " " + countInside);
    }
}
